news.title: Anthropic’s potential $2 trillion IPO comes with the following fine print
news.description: Anthropic’s revenue grew over 10-fold in 2025, but the cost of training and serving its models is also climbing.
news.author: Christine Ji

copy.hook: Revenue up 10x in a year. So why does the IPO come with fine print?
copy.explain: Anthropic's revenue grew more than 10x in 2025. But every Claude answer runs on expensive chips, and training each new model costs even more. If costs rise as fast as sales, profit (money left over) barely moves. That's the catch behind a potential $2 trillion price tag.
copy.takeaway: Sales growth only builds profit when costs grow slower than revenue.
copy.question: What matters more for Anthropic's IPO: 10x sales growth or its rising model costs?
